text: bhante bhagavā anusāsatu maṃ bhante bhagavā yaṃ mama assa dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyāti . evaṃ #1 po. abhippasannāni . 2 ma. kathaṃ . vutte maṃ bhante bhagavā etadavoca evametaṃ gahapati evametaṃ gahapati āturo hāyaṃ 1 gahapati kāyo aṇḍabhūto pariyonaddho yo hi gahapati imaṃ kāyaṃ pariharanto muhuttaṃpi ārogyaṃ paṭijāneyya kimaññatra bālyā tasmā tiha te gahapati evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ āturakāyassa me sato
